column4: the row's own keys are JavaScript symbols, and a record here is a string-keyed map with no symbol-keyed variant
the row asserts a non-enumerable own property is never read; a Rust map holds exactly the entries it was given, so there is no enumerability to observe
the key check is a predicate over JavaScript symbols (Symbol.keyFor) and the keys themselves are symbols
the key is a specific JavaScript symbol identity, which a string-keyed map cannot hold
the catch-all record's keys are symbols under a StructWithRest; the string-keyed half of the same shape is carried by the row beside it
